title: Appeal 15739: one-hour fire wall by adding gypsum to an existing wall instead of re-siding (OSSC Table 602)
jurisdiction: City of Portland, Oregon (USA), Bureau of Development Services Administrative Appeal Board; non-Alberta comparative record
code_edition: 2014 OSSC Table 602 (as stated in the info sheet)

facts.text: Appeal item: OSSC Table 602 requires a one-hour rated fire wall for an existing building on the same lot; the proposal adds two layers of 5/8-inch Type X gypsum to the interior side.
Stated reason: a one-hour wall with 5/8-inch Type X on both sides would require removing the existing siding and is cost-prohibitive; the applicant says the design meets fire distance requirements.
Decision: granted as proposed with fire blocking per OSSC 718.2.
